headline: Malaysia's Big Caring Raises $155 Million in Country's Largest Pharmacy IPO
summary: Big Caring Group, Malaysia's largest pharmacy chain operator, raised 637.8 million ringgit ($155 million) in an initial public offering.
why: The listing is one of Malaysia's notable retail healthcare offerings, reflecting capital market activity in Southeast Asian consumer health services.

impacts.name: Big Caring Group
impacts.why: The pharmacy operator completed a 637.8 million ringgit IPO in Malaysia.
